<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex87032023-03-1610-18-48" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="223.232.211.112.1 "/>
            de la gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs zhes bya ba ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo</rs></note> na re <quote source="db:4445" n="216,4-7"><!--TODO ref to the typeset edition-->rtags kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid tshul gsum dang mtshon bya gtan tshigs kyi 'brel pa nges par byed pa la</quote> zer ba yin gyi <note type="editorial">The first part of the citation, up to "zer" corresponds to <mentioned>rNam bshad</mentioned> 216,4-7 de la gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid tshul gsum dang | de'i mtshon bya'i 'brel pa nges par byed pa ni gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid la |.</note> 
            <note type="gloss"><choice><orig>° gnyegs </orig><reg><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4264">gnyags ye shes 'bar</rs></reg></choice> ltar</note> <note type="editorial">Identification upon assumption that "gnyegs" stands for "gnyags ye shes 'bar" (id:4264)</note> tshul dang po'i mtshan mtshon gyi 'brel pa gtan la 'bebs pa ni ma yin te rtags kyi sgra tshul dang po <lb n="31a1"/> kho na la nye ba'i rgyu <choice><orig>‹mtshan›</orig><reg>mtshan</reg></choice> med pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ro || 
         <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3809">khyung</rs> na re</note> 'di ni mi rigs te | de ltar na khyab pa'i mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa yang gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs par 'gyur la 'dod na rtags kyi mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs su rjes su dpag bya'i sgra rtsod gzhi' kho na la 'jug par ji ltar 'gyur te de'i tshe chos la'ang 'jug pa'i phyir ro || des na 'dir gtan tshigs ni tshul dang po la bya ste tshul dang po'i mtshan nyid <lb n="31a2"/> dang mtshon bya'i 'brel pa gtan la 'bebs pa la gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs zhes brjod par bya'o ||</seg></TEI>
